Know About Overstaying and Penalties In Abu Dhabi

Due to Abu Dhabi’s strict visa policies, overstaying may result in penalties. The length of your overstay and the kind of visa you have will determine the punishment. Residents may be subject to harsher penalties, while those with tourist or visitation visas may be subject to daily fines. To prevent additional fees, always verify the validity of your visa.

  • After the grace period, holders of tourist and visitation visas would be fined Price on Request per day.
  • The first day’s fine is Price on Request and it rises with each additional day of overstay for holders of residence visas: 
  •  In order to pay off the overstay penalty, there can be a Price on Request service charge and some time extra charges as well.
